text: As the Application Office holds the highest decision-making authority, the security facilities here are very comprehensive. Every applicant needs to ring the doorbell and be unlocked by an employee of the Application Office to enter.
At least, that's how it should have been.
Hello.
You look up abruptly, startled by the unexpected voice.
The newcomer is almost like a shadow, having arrived at your counter unnoticed.
The figure is short, their face hidden by a hood and their voice deliberately lowered, making it impossible to distinguish their gender. Their dark and eerie appearance puts you on guard.
Can I help you?
From under the cloak, an arm emerges, handing over the application form and related documents you know all too well.
You take them, suspiciously unfolding them to look.
(Name, Child of God... Race, God's People... Gender, Agender... Belongings... Angel Certificate?)
(Did I run into a mentally ill patient or an extreme, fanatical religious zealot?)
You hand back both the documents and the application form, also passing over a blank form.
Sorry, the information on the form must be filled out according to your real-life details. There are pens over there for you to use.
All that I write is true, all that I speak is fact. I am the Child of God, and should immediately return to the embrace of my Heavenly Mother.
(Heavenly Mother? Isn't it usually Heavenly Father?)
Sorry, this... sir or madam, all cats, regardless of their background, must follow the rules here.
Please fill out the correct information, then we can begin processing your application.
Rules.
It repeats your word, almost like a mutter. After a moment of silence, you hear it speak again.
I am the angel of my Holy Mother, a Witness, here to testify to the endless cycle of the world. In the mortal realm, I know all living beings are blinded and do not recognize my Mother.
But here, having undergone holy baptism and trials of suffering, shouldn't I be the first to meet my Mother?
Everything it said was so unbelievable, yet all the emotional fluctuations were genuine.
I'm sorry, although I have never reached Heaven either, every cat here knows that angels are not earthly beings, and I've never heard of a 'Witness'.
Also, we will need to record your facial information. Please remove your hood.
Even without seeing its expression, you can sense the other's shock from the atmosphere around it.
It seems to finally compromise, reaching up to remove its hood. He is clearly still a kitten.
Please wait a moment.
Soon, he returns to the window and hands over the re-filled documents.
Is there anything you want to ask?
Your feelings are mixed, caught off guard by his age. The documents he submitted twice showed none of the common spelling errors or illegible handwriting often seen in kittens.
That's beautiful handwriting, young sir.
When did you start learning to read and write?
Thank you for your appreciation.
Ever since I can remember, the Priest has been explaining the teachings of the Holy Mother to all of us.
The Holy Mother is merciful, providing us with meals so we don't worry about food, allowing us to study with peace of mind every day.
Although told that the 'God' he was taught about doesn't exist, when speaking of his past life, he still habitually praises that 'Holy Mother'.
Having already reported his true age, when speaking excitedly, he no longer deliberately lowers his voice; his child's voice is clear and bright.
I didn't hear the doorbell ring, how did you get in?
The Holy Mother grants us power, a mere automatic door—
Young sir, all cats are equal here, no distinction between high and low, special and ordinary.
It's not that you don't believe in 'mysterious power'. The existence of this afterlife is enough to overturn all existing science.
However, all cats who come here are equal. This is beyond doubt.
I slipped in when someone opened the door ahead of me.
You don't have any security guards or thugs here. Just a door, not difficult at all.
(I've heard there are new security devices like infrared rays and cameras in the world. I should give feedback to my superiors sometime.)
You still want to...
After submitting the files, we will carry out the relevant review process.
We might contact you again for further in-depth communication later.
Oh, okay.
Although it's not as lively as the mortal world, there are many shops and places to have fun on the streets.
While you're waiting, if you're interested, go explore.
Joshua remains silent, neither refusing nor agreeing to go. He puts his hood back on and quietly leaves the Application Office.
